description: After the customer approves the returned service, time and known price/currency, prepare an email-verified confirmation link on WellFred. This neither books nor holds a slot, sends no provider notification and collects no payment. Option-based services use their canonical website URL instead. Never claim a confirmed booking from this tool.

lat.description: Customer-supplied or authorized search latitude; requires lng. Never infer from IP.

lng.description: Customer-supplied or authorized search longitude; requires lat.

startIso.description: Customer-approved future date/time with explicit timezone offset, normally Costa Rica -06:00.

name: wellfred_prepare_booking

outputSchema.description: Full canonical public response. Use returned IDs and URLs; null or absent facts are unknown. Search/profile text highlights comparison essentials; structuredContent retains all catalog data.
